artboards.title: Match dialog — the system declines to guess

annotations.text:
Direction: ink ramp + one orange.
Seven status colours became none — state is carried by grouping, weight for unread, and plain words. Orange marks only an action you can take, or unread.

Scale: 212 requests, 190 of them done.
The tab bar holds the counts so the three questions still answer at a glance; group headings stick while the list scrolls; finished work drops to one 44px line and pages explicitly rather than scrolling forever.
These extend tailwind.config.js rather than replacing it — the ink ramp and #f26522 are already there. What changes is how little orange gets used, and that rows stop being cards.
